subject: exp-info-b
title: (R)EXP.INFO.B. -----LANG.DY.
description: Diagram in CMOA(II)-34, second of two on book p276, paired with v2-p276-1. Continues the Japan analysis by holding expansion-information-basis at its real register against language-dynamics — language being the operational vehicle of culture-gap. (R)EXP-INFO-B (the reality of expansion information basis) is crossed with LANG-DY (language dynamics): the question is what expansion-information-basis produces in its actual instantiation when crossed with language-dynamics — the (R) prefix marking that the actual Japanese creative experience exists (against Western denial), and language-dynamics is precisely what determines whether that experience can become internationally legible. The main line drops from the subject to LANG-DY on the lower-left. LANG-DY appears a second time, without a dot of its own, on the upper line that leaves the main line and ends at (R)SG (the reality of source initiation) at the upper-center. From this upper LANG-DY run MT-INFO (multi-information), with PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) branching from it at the bottom, and (R)STY (reality of style). From the (R)STY line branch (P)POST (postulation at its point of idea completion) and AFTD (affinity tendencies), which anchors the upper-right; C-CONT (composite continuance) branches from AFTD, and SOC (society) and ALT-F (alternative functionalism) branch from C-CONT. Structural argument: expansion-information-basis-as-real crossed with language-dynamics carries all of its side structure through the second LANG-DY, with reality-of-style as the hub of the right-hand branches. The doubled LANG-DY exposes Braxton's structural commitment that language-dynamics functions at two simultaneous registers: as the crossing-partner (the structural axis) and as the junction on the upper line from which the side branches run (the operational mechanism). The (r) prefix on style commits that real Japanese style actually obtains and can ground composite-continuance.
